decisions.reason: The Exp4 Definition explicitly takes an instance of def-contextual-bandit-protocol, whose Definition requires x_t in [0,1]^k. Its justified_by lemma proves positive simplex weights and finite nonnegative estimated losses, including zero-probability arms. Thus -eta times estimated loss is nonpositive and F2 applies. The proposed R>1 counterexample violates the input scope. The log-majorant and fixed-expert telescoping steps are valid for every finite eta>0.

Original F4/step 2.1 applies the conditional-moment lemma in the estimator Definition, which requires P_{t,j}>0 for every arm j; an Exp4 history may have P=(1,0). Positivity of only the selected coordinate does not meet that inherited interface. Repaired by deriving its mean directly as P_i times (1-x_i)/P_i and then summing expert advice; unsupported coefficients vanish because Q_m>0. The statement is unchanged.

Original F4/step 2.1 invokes the conditional-moment supplier under the full-support estimator Definition, but Exp4 allows histories with zero sampling probabilities. The supported coordinate alone does not satisfy that interface. Repaired by computing its conditional square directly as P_i times (1-x_i)^2/P_i^2. Cross terms vanish since only the sampled action estimate can be nonzero; summing Q_m cancels supported P_i denominators and leaves at most k. The statement is unchanged.
